cohort: The study included 350 women with a live singleton fetus in the cephalic position who had induced labor at term (>=37 weeks), divided into cases (emergency caesarean section) and controls (vaginal delivery).
finding: Maternal age >=35 years, BMI >=30 kg/m2, nulliparity, preinduction Bishop's score <5, gestational diabetes mellitus, and intrauterine growth restriction were significantly associated with emergency caesarean delivery in induced labors at term.
